operation: Factor out the term that does not depend on k
reasoning: The exponential exp(I*Omega*(n-k)) = exp(I*Omega*n) * exp(-I*Omega*k) by exponential properties. Since exp(I*Omega*n) does not depend on the summation variable k, it can be factored out of the sum, leaving Sum(h[k] * exp(-I*Omega*k), (k, -oo, oo)).
